correctness.rationale: Writing k=b2c, A=a3 k^2, B0=-k(a2+2a3b1), C0=a2b1+a3b1^2 gives the third-step scalar psi(X)=AX^2+B0 X+C0. The forced affine normalization s=-4/A and t=(4-B0)/(2A) makes psi(t+sv)=t+4s v(1-v) precisely on the boxed equation (the constant identity is 4AC0-B0^2+2B0+8=0). Direct substitution into Phi(u,v,w)=(t+su,b1-k(t+sv),c(t+sw)) yields F Phi=Phi(g(v),w,u). This full-cube conjugacy proves invariant box and measure via tent conjugacy, ergodic exactness of its cube, entropy and Lyapunov exponents. The residue classes n mod 3 reduce fixed points to g^n and give 2^n; DG^{3n} diagonal gives the periodic repelling bound. Boundary b1=0 and n=1 included. All claims are box-relative; uniqueness restricted to absolutely continuous measures; finite tests alone are not universal proofs.
